name: Classic Double Leather Collar
label: 12 mm, 20–24 cm

size.quote: ширина 12 мм, обхват шеи от 20 до 24 см

texts.about_this_item: Kaskad Classic dog collar made of two layers of genuine high-quality leather with strong metal fittings. Width 12 mm, fits a neck girth of 20–24 cm. Steel D-ring, 5 adjustment holes and a metal buckle. Leather colours vary (assorted). Made in Russia.

review_note: New product: 1282 is single-layer, 1322 double with rhinestones. Page gives one photo only; colour assorted (photo shows blue).
